opioid_population.long_name: Total population of the area reported alongside the opioid overdose snapshot
opioid_population.short_description: Total population of the geography as reported alongside the opioid overdose EMS outcome.
opioid_population.long_description: Total population denominator reported for a given county, state, or national area alongside the opioid overdose snapshot. Provided for context, not as an independent outcome measure. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).

opioid_ems_rate_low.long_name: Lower bound of the rate of EMS patient encounters for fatal and non-fatal opioid overdoses per 100,000 population
opioid_ems_rate_low.short_description: Lower bound of the opioid EMS encounter rate range for this county.
opioid_ems_rate_low.long_description: The opioid overdose EMS encounter rate is reported only as a range (e.g. "3.0 to 3.9"), never as a single point value. This is the numeric lower bound of that range. Use alongside opioid_ems_rate_high and opioid_ems_rate_label -- do not average low/high into a point estimate. Reported at real county FIPS geography. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
opioid_ems_rate_low.statement: In {location}, the opioid overdose EMS encounter rate fell between {value} and {opioid_ems_rate_high} per 100,000 population.

opioid_ems_rate_high.long_name: Upper bound of the rate of EMS patient encounters for fatal and non-fatal opioid overdoses per 100,000 population
opioid_ems_rate_high.short_description: Upper bound of the opioid EMS encounter rate range for this county.
opioid_ems_rate_high.long_description: Numeric upper bound of the same map-legend bucket described in opioid_ems_rate_low. See that field's description for the bucket-vs-point-estimate caveat. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
opioid_ems_rate_high.statement: In {location}, the opioid overdose EMS encounter rate fell between {opioid_ems_rate_low} and {value} per 100,000 population.

opioid_ems_rate_label.long_name: Qualitative label for the opioid overdose EMS encounter rate range, relative to the national average
opioid_ems_rate_label.short_description: Text label describing this county's opioid EMS encounter rate relative to the national average.
opioid_ems_rate_label.long_description: A qualitative classification of the opioid EMS rate bucket, ranging from "Low Outlier" through "High Outlier", or "No Data" where the area had no reportable rate. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 07/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-07-31).
opioid_ems_rate_label.statement: In {location}, the opioid overdose EMS rate was classified as "{value}".
